sentences: The rs1801133 variant is a missense change in the MTHFR gene, described as NM_005957.5(MTHFR):c.665C>T (p.Ala222Val) [F2].

The alternate A allele (G>A) is present on 32% of alleles in the gnomAD v4 exome dataset (471698/1461758 alleles; af 0.322692), with frequencies ranging from 49% in Admixed American individuals to 11% in African/African American individuals [F4, F5].

ClinVar submissions with the highest review level disagree on its clinical significance, reporting 5 benign/likely benign, 3 pathogenic/likely pathogenic, and 3 uncertain significance assertions, and also note associations with drug response (methotrexate toxicity) and other traits [F6, F7].
